consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on March 10, 1993, at Rosemont Horizon was strong, particularly in the first set, with Jerry Garcia delivering impressive solos and the band displaying tight cohesion. While the second set had some weaker moments, standout jams and energetic performances kept the overall experience enjoyable.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 36 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the performance, some noted clunky moments in the second set and expressed disappointment with certain song choices, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
